label: DAY 5
title: People who searched for my Short watched it twice as long as swipers.

scenes.title: 8 people searched and found me
lines: Eight people typed something into YouTube search, and landed on my first Short.

scenes.title: search_terms.txt
lines: Studio shows me exactly one of those searches. How to upload AI videos on YouTube.

scenes.title: Average % watched, by how they found it
lines: Here's what surprised me. The searchers watched fifty six percent of it, on average.
Channel page visitors, forty five. People swiping the Shorts feed, just twenty five.
Three views from other features watched the most, but that's three people.

scenes.label: searchers vs swipers
lines: Searchers stayed thirty three seconds. Swipers, fifteen. Tiny numbers, but it's my first real signal.

scenes.text: Prediction: Day 4 beats Day 3 in search views
lines: So I'm testing titles that answer a search.
Prediction: yesterday's voice Short gets more search views than Day three. I'll check next Sunday.
